ops.title: cc-transcript 14.40.1 warm scope identity, cursor and byte bounds (verified for host-wide warm coalescing)
ops.body:
Verified against the exact-tag cc-transcript 14.40.1 source while designing host-wide warm coalescing (Lane B of the 2026-10-12 cache/IO fixes, note d73db18). Paths are under rust/crates/core/src in cc-transcript.

Scope identity
- Registered warm membership key = sha256(canonical JSON of thread_ids, roots, direct_paths, active_since_unix_ms, registry_generation, admission, authority). No claimant, no owner_epoch. snapshot_prepared_service.rs:702-718.
- Foreground prepare_graph looks the membership up under the same key and answers incomplete "registered membership is not warmed" when it is absent (:833-847). Warming is a precondition for registered graph evidence, not only an optimization.
- At most 32 memberships (:1662), each expiring 30 minutes after it was built (:1644), oldest expiry evicted first.
- registry_generation is a content fingerprint of the tool definitions (snapshot.rs:3234-3250), stable across owner generations.
- Root warm load slot is keyed by source stamp identity and checked against path and registry_generation (snapshot_root_warm.rs:19-74); claimant is recorded on the waiter only.

Cursor
- Caller-carried: start_index + membership_revision. start_index > 0 with a different revision answers status=changed (:1752-1762). Native keeps no per-caller member cursor.
- Per-source partial progress lives in the shared prepared_loads slot (:1916-1924).
- A step that hits its read limit, or its deadline after reading, answers ok with the advanced cursor (:1797-1807, :1856-1869). A deadline at a member boundary or a cancel answers an error with no data: the caller keeps its last cursor, native keeps the bytes and facts.
- An in-flight load join is non-blocking, so an ok reply with zero progress can mean another caller is loading that source.

Byte bounds
- Warm steps run with PreparedCacheReads::Within(remaining.max_source_read_bytes); prepared-cache bytes are subtracted from the same budget as source bytes (:445-465, :1777; snapshot_root_warm.rs:161-165). One warm step's source + prepared-cache reads are bounded together by limits.max_source_read_bytes.
- warm_registered answers complete only when prepared_disk.has_entry holds for every active member, else retained_limit (:1898-1913).
- Background work gets 3 of 4 pending load slots (1 reserved for hooks). A partially warmed source holds its slot until it completes or its pin expires.

Consequences for Captain Hook
- One host claimant can drive a scope for every worker; no producer change is needed for host-wide coalescing.
- A cursor parked at the end of a walk must not be retained across a stall: if earlier members' facts were evicted, completion answers retained_limit forever. Restart from index 0 instead.
- The host scope key must cover members, window, tool-registry content, admission and authority, or it joins scopes native keeps apart.

Design artifact attached (warm-scope-design.json, v2).
